## The Amazon aboard Tukano

On board, you will find air-conditioned cabins with private bathrooms, meals prepared by the chef and evening dinners. Between excursions, you can relax on the vessel or by the water, and watch sunsets over the river in the evening.

### Before the cruise

We recommend arriving in Manaus at least 1 day before boarding, so you have time to prepare for the journey and explore the city. Accommodation in Manaus is not included in the cruise price.
